newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Salomon's Asia boss Rowe to base in Sydney.
newsitem.headline: Salomon's Asia boss Rowe to base in Sydney.

text.p: Investment bank Salomon Bros Inc said on Monday that Trevor Rowe, chairman of Salomon Bros Asia Pacific and the head of Asia Pacific Investment Banking, would relocate to Sydney from Hong Kong in January, 1998.
Rowe, who established the Australian operations last decade, moved from Sydney to Hong Kong in 1994.
He told Reuters that he would retain both titles, with Asian staff continuing to report to him in Sydney.
"He has built a first class business in Asia and we now feel the time is right for him to move back to Sydney," Salomon Bros Inc chairman and chief executive Deryck Maughan said.

"He will continue to provide senior coverage for clients in the Asia Pacific region as well as strengthening his already prominent position in the Australian business community," Maughan said in a statement.
